tcp_interface.description: IP address the AMQP TCP listener binds to. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces or a specific IP to restrict access.

tcp_port.description: TCP port for plain (unencrypted) AMQP 0-9-1 client connections.

heartbeat.description: Heartbeat interval in seconds. Connections idle longer than this are considered dead and closed. 0 disables heartbeats.

frame_max.description: Maximum AMQP frame payload size in bytes. Increase for large messages; decrease to reduce per-connection memory use.

channel_max.description: Maximum number of AMQP channels per TCP connection. 0 means unlimited — always set a bound to prevent runaway clients.

consumer_timeout.description: Milliseconds a delivered message may remain unacknowledged before RabbitMQ force-closes the consumer channel.

default_vhost.description: Virtual host created automatically on first broker startup. Acts as the default namespace for queues and exchanges.

default_user.description: Administrator username created on first startup. Rename or delete before exposing the broker to any network.

default_pass.description: Password for the default administrator account. Must be changed for any non-local deployment.

loopback_users.description: Usernames that may only connect from localhost (127.0.0.1 or ::1). Remove the built-in guest entry after creating a named admin.

memory_high_watermark.description: Fraction of total RAM (0.0–1.0) at which RabbitMQ begins flow-controlling publishers. Lower values leave more headroom for the OS.

disk_free_limit.description: Minimum free disk space (e.g. 50MB, 2GB) below which all publishers are blocked. Prevents the broker from filling the disk.

log_dir.description: Filesystem path where RabbitMQ writes log files. Must be writable by the rabbitmq OS user.

log_level.description: Verbosity of the main log file. One of: debug, info, warning, error, critical, none.

management_bind_address.description: IP address the management HTTP API and web UI listens on. Restrict to 127.0.0.1 unless the UI must be reached remotely.

management_port.description: TCP port for the RabbitMQ management HTTP API and browser-based UI.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable an additional TLS listener for encrypted AMQP connections alongside (or instead of) the plain TCP listener.

ssl_port.description: TCP port for TLS-encrypted AMQP connections. Only active when ssl_enabled is true.

ssl_cacertfile.description: Absolute path to the PEM CA certificate bundle used to verify client certificates.

ssl_certfile.description: Absolute path to the PEM server certificate presented to connecting AMQP clients.

ssl_keyfile.description: Absolute path to the PEM private key corresponding to ssl_certfile.

ssl_verify.description: TLS peer verification mode: verify_peer requires a valid client certificate; verify_none skips client cert validation.

ssl_fail_if_no_peer_cert.description: Reject TLS connections from clients that send no certificate. Only meaningful when ssl_verify is verify_peer.

cluster_nodes.description: Erlang node names (e.g. rabbit@hostname) of all nodes in the cluster used for static peer discovery. Leave empty for standalone deployments.

mqtt_enabled.description: Enable the MQTT plugin listener to accept MQTT 3.1/3.1.1 client connections (requires rabbitmq_mqtt plugin).

mqtt_port.description: TCP port for MQTT client connections. Only active when mqtt_enabled is true.

stomp_enabled.description: Enable the STOMP plugin listener to accept STOMP text-protocol connections (requires rabbitmq_stomp plugin).

stomp_port.description: TCP port for STOMP client connections. Only active when stomp_enabled is true.
